49r18519bd.data:
- The methodology involves investigating the interactions between attention heads and specialized next-token neurons in the Multilayer Perceptron.
- The researchers prompt a large language model (LLM) like GPT-4 to explain the model internals, focusing on attention mechanisms that activate specific next-token neurons.
- The analysis identifies attention heads that recognize contexts relevant to predicting particular tokens, activating associated neurons through residual connections.
- The study emphasizes the consistent activation of the same next-token neuron by heads in earlier layers across similar prompts.
- The methodology combines neural explanations with probing isolated components to reveal how attention facilitates context-dependent processing in LLMs.
